description: Defines the class HTMLPurifier_Node_Element, representing an element node in the HTMLPurifier library. It manages tag name, attributes, children, and token conversion methods.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Node_Element
classes.description: Represents an HTML element node, with properties for tag name, attributes, children, and methods for token conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an element node with tag name, attributes, line, column, and armor data.

methods.name: toTokenPair
methods.description: Converts the element node into a pair of tokens, either as empty or start/end tokens depending on the element type.
